verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for small-business accounting SaaS, but Wave's evidence shows no assistant you can delegate tasks to. The nearest features, OCR receipt extraction, bank-transaction auto-categorization and scheduled invoice reminders, are rule-based automations rather than an assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
